description: A clock that only runs forward: one key (D minor), one grid, one direction. State the minor mode, step the tempo up once at ~3:00, drop into a short dark valley, then spend the whole second half louder and harmonically narrower until only the D pedal is left. The finale peaks as it ends — loudest window, then a deep cut, then a loud dark close on the tonic. No modulation, no ambiguity, no fade.
name: timetable

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Quietest stretch in the track (mean -19.1dB, opens at -30.5dB). State D minor sparsely; first downbeat not until ~6s. Patient, empty.

sections.name: Groove A (~136 BPM)
sections.notes: First long statement at the slower tempo. Mid-level energy with waves: dips to -18.9dB at 1:05 and -18.5dB at 1:40, loud entries at 1:10 (-5.8dB). Full D-minor pitch set, Bb and C present. Brightest timbre in the track.

sections.name: Groove B (gear-change to 143.6)
sections.notes: Tempo steps up at 3:00 — the step IS the transition, no riser needed. Louder sustained stretch (mean -8.0dB) heading into the valley.

sections.name: Valley
sections.notes: 28s dark interlude. Centroid collapses to 726Hz at 3:35 (darkest in the track), dip to -20.4dB at 3:45. The hinge between halves — let the darkness be the section.

sections.name: Pedal grind
sections.notes: The long peak: 3+ minutes, mean -6.4dB, loudest sustained stretch (loudest 30s -4.6dB at 7:00-7:30). Harmony strips to a near-pure D pedal (chroma D 0.96-1.00). Louder and narrower at once — that is the whole section.

sections.name: Finale
sections.notes: Opens on the loudest single window in the track (-2.4dB at 7:20), then a -21.9dB cut at 7:35 — the finale interrupts itself — then climbs back to -2.7dB at 8:00 and ends loud-and-dark (-7.1dB, centroid 749Hz, rolloff 990Hz). No fade. End on D, at the ceiling.
